event_context.format: Short workflow demos, Cursor talk/AMA, networking.
prioritize: Builders who describe concrete Cursor workflows (rules, agents, MCP, etc.)
People shipping real products or tools others use
Engineers and technical founders who can contribute to discussion
deprioritize: Spam, gibberish, or empty one-word answers
Obvious copy-paste / LLM boilerplate with no personal detail
event_context.notes: Illustrative defaults for a builder meetup — edit per event. Missing social links alone is not a decline reason.

fields.building: What are you building with Cursor?
fields.question: Any questions for the Cursor team?
fields.showcase: Would you like to showcase any cool workflows in how you use Cursor? If yes, please explain what you'd like to showcase.
fields.how_heard: How did you hear about this?
